name: Eastern Strand
summary: The Eastern Strand is a stretch of southern coastline in Hillsbrad Foothills, lying to the southeast toward the border of the Arathi Highlands. Once peaceful shores, the beaches and shallows have been overrun by hostile Daggerspine naga establishing a coastal beachhead.

sections.title: A Hostile Shoreline
sections.body: Running along the southeastern edge of Hillsbrad Foothills, the Eastern Strand complements the Western Strand across the bay. While the region is primarily known for human farming settlements and territorial clashes between Southshore and Tarren Mill, these sandy flats and tidelines are dominated entirely by the Daggerspine naga. Creeping out of the Great Sea, the serpent folk slither across the sandbars and dwell among the rocky outcrops, watching the mainland closely.

sections.title: Daggerspine Territory
sections.body: The Daggerspine presence creates a dangerous shoreline southeast of Southshore. Their warriors and spellcasters prowl the beaches and nearby water, making the coast hazardous to travelers.

faq.q: Where is the Eastern Strand located?
faq.answer: The Eastern Strand encompasses the coastal sands and shallows in the southeastern corner of Hillsbrad Foothills, sitting eastward along the water toward the borders of the Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: What creatures inhabit the Eastern Strand?
faq.answer: The beach and nearby waters are overrun by the Daggerspine tribe of naga, including foot soldiers, raiders, and spellcasters prowling the tideline.

faq.q: Why are the naga gathering on this beach?
aliases: what are the naga doing here
faq.answer: The Daggerspine occupy the beaches and water of the Eastern Strand. Their purpose beyond holding this coastal territory is unrecorded in the Classic account.

faq.q: How does the Eastern Strand differ from the Western Strand?
faq.answer: Both strands are occupied by Daggerspine naga, but they bracket the southern coast of Hillsbrad on opposite sides, with the Western Strand sitting southwest toward Silverpine and the Eastern Strand lying southeast toward Arathi.

angles.text: The naga encamped on the Eastern Strand pose a direct, creeping flank threat to Southshore's maritime security and nearby patrols.
Any organized naga expansion moving inland from the coast threatens to destabilize Horde movements and supply lines crossing lower Hillsbrad.
